input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2 imposes a liquidated early-termination payment on us (the Company/customer): 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000, payable in eight quarterly instalments. It is uncapped, unrelated to fees actually payable (30% of Net Sales over $11,000/month under Section 3.1), and triggered by any termination by us — including termination for HDI's non-performance. That breaches the preferred position of no customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties. Because HDI funds the site build, hosting and promotion under a pure revenue-share model, we took the fallback: a single early-termination fee capped at three months' Section 3.1 fees, payable only on termination for convenience and not where we terminate under Section 1.6 or for HDI's breach.

proposal.summary: Replace the Net Sales-based Termination Payment with a three-month fee cap payable only on termination for convenience.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we should not owe liquidated damages or penalties on termination; as HDI funds the site build and hosting, we can accept a single early-termination fee capped at three months' fees under Section 3.1, payable only if we terminate for convenience. The existing formula (50% of a year's Net Sales above $800,000) is an uncapped penalty far exceeding HDI's revenue share and would even apply where we terminate for HDI's failure to perform.

ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement for convenience upon notice pursuant to Section 4.1, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment (the "Termination Payment") in an amount equal to the aggregate fees payable by the Company to HDI pursuant to Section 3.1 in respect of the three (3) calendar months immediately preceding the Termination Date, which amount shall be the sole and exclusive amount payable by the Company in connection with such termination. No Termination Payment or other liquidated amount, penalty or damages shall be payable by the Company where the Company terminates this Agreement pursuant to Section 1.6 or as a result of HDI's breach of this Agreement.
